Justice Breyer questioned the existence of a health exemption.

sections.heading: What this case is about
paragraphs: New Hampshire requires doctors to notify parents before a minor gets an abortion. Doctors can seek a court order to skip this step. The state says this process is safe. Doctors say it creates dangerous delays and legal risks.
